qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Physically irreplaceable liquids and gas transmission network, but returns are structurally constrained by utility rate-base regulation and negotiated toll settlements. 5-year median GAAP ROIC of 6.6% falls far short of the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (gate_3b = N). Enbridge owns irreplaceable energy transmission infrastructure, but its 5-year median GAAP ROIC of 6.6% (tangible ROIC ~8.6%) fails the 12% hurdle. Returns are structurally limited by cost-of-service regulation and massive capital intensity.
qualitative.evidence: Enbridge operates North America's largest midstream and gas utility network (Mainline, gas transmission, gas distribution). However, high capital intensity and rate-regulated toll structures prevent economic rent extraction. 5-year median GAAP ROIC is 6.58% (FY22: 3.8%, FY23: 6.9%, FY24: 6.3%, FY25: 7.4%). Balance sheet carries CAD $98.9B in long-term debt against CAD $7.1B net income.
